title: Vendor always shows in the part window, for every user
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • A second user, {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL User B), has the custom role {Role-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL VENDOR ROLE), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit' on, Delete off and See Financial Data off, and access to {Location-A}.
  • {User-B} is signed in at {Location-A} in a second browser (or a private window).
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL Vendor Shows) exists.
  • Part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-VENDOR-01) is stocked at {Location-A} with Vendor {Vendor-A}.
custom_steps:
1. As the Admin, go to Parts → Inventory and click New Inventory Part.
  2. Click Cancel.
  3. As the Admin, type {Part-A} in the Inventory search.
  4. Click the {Part-A} row.
  5. Click Cancel.
  6. As {User-B}, go to Parts → Inventory and click New Inventory Part.
  7. Click Cancel.
  8. As {User-B}, type {Part-A} in the Inventory search.
  9. Click the {Part-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the New Inventory Part window shows a Vendor field, after Part Number.
  • Step 4: Edit Inventory Part shows the Vendor field, holding {Vendor-A}.
  • Step 6: {User-B} also sees the Vendor field in New Inventory Part, even without financial data or Delete.
  • Step 9: {User-B} sees the Vendor field holding {Vendor-A}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S13-R4a, S13-R4, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.1 (New Inventory Part opens), board 2.1 (The part as it stands), 13 Oct copy. Product's 9 Oct answer (Chris Ward, question 6); story SV-10826 acceptance criteria. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R4a: “Vendor always shows. Cost, Average Cost, Sell Price and Core Charge show only to a user who can see financial data. Min and Max show only while tracking is on (S4-R5).”
  • S13-R4: “The fields appear in this order: Description, Part Number, Part Status (editing only), Vendor, Category, Manufacturer, Average Cost (editing) or Cost (creating), Sell Price, Core Charge, Inventory Tracking (the switch, then Min and Max), Tags, and Inventory (bin locations, then "Add Bin Location").”
  • SV-10826 acceptance criteria: “Given any screen that opens the part dialog, when it opens, then the Vendor field shows.”
